arxiv-2107-01618.title: Estimating Counts Through an Average Rounded to the Nearest Non-negative Integer and its Theoretical & Practical Effects
arxiv-2107-01618.creator: Roberto Rivera, Axel Cortés-Cubero, Israel Almodóvar-Rivera, Wolfgang Rolke
arxiv-2107-01618.description: Abstract \papertype Original Article \paperfield Journal Section \contrib [ \authfn 1]Equally contributing authors. \corremail roberto.rivera30@upr.edu \fundinginfo NSF, OAC, Grant/Award Number: 1940179 Abstract In practice, the use of rounding is ubiquitous. Although researchers have looked at the implications of rounding continuous random variables, rounding may also be applied to functions of discrete random variables.

arxiv-2311-02573.title: Group Testing for Accurate and Efficient Range-Based Near Neighbor Search for Plagiarism Detection
arxiv-2311-02573.creator: Harsh Shah, Kashish Mittal, Ajit Rajwade
arxiv-2311-02573.description: Abstract This work presents an adaptive group testing framework for the range-based high dimensional near neighbor search problem. Our method efficiently marks each item in a database as neighbor or non-neighbor of a query point, based on a cosine distance threshold without exhaustive search.

arxiv-2409-02960.title: Managing multiple agents by automatically adjusting incentives
arxiv-2409-02960.creator: Shunichi Akatsuka, Yaemi Teramoto, Aaron Courville
arxiv-2409-02960.description: Abstract In the coming years, AI agents will be used for making more complex decisions, including in situations involving many different groups of people. One big challenge is that AI agent tends to act in its own interest, unlike humans who often think about what will be the best for everyone in the long run.

arxiv-2412-19894.title: Chirality-induced pseudo-magnetic fields, flat bands and enhancement of superconductivity
arxiv-2412-19894.creator: Zhiyu Dong, Leonid Levitov, Patrick A. Lee
arxiv-2412-19894.description: Abstract Systems in which exchange interactions couple carrier spins to a spin texture with a net chirality exhibit a spin-dependent Aharonov-Bohm effect, where the geometric gauge field and pseudo-magnetic field have opposite signs for carriers with opposite spins. As a result, Cooper pairs see a net zero vector potential and superconducting pairing is not hindered by pair-breaking effects.

arxiv-2509-23128.title: Conditional Risk Minimization with Side Information: A Tractable, Universal Optimal Transport Framework
arxiv-2509-23128.creator: Xinqiao Xie, Jonathan Yu-Meng Li
arxiv-2509-23128.description: Abstract Abstract Conditional risk minimization arises in high-stakes decisions where risk must be assessed in light of side information–such as stressed economic conditions, specific customer profiles, or other contextual covariates. Constructing reliable conditional distributions from limited data is notoriously difficult, motivating a series of optimal-transport-based proposals that address this uncertainty in a distributionally robust manner.

arxiv-2509-25294.title: On étale maps of sous-perfectoid adic spaces
arxiv-2509-25294.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . We prove a proposition for étale maps of sous-perfectoid adic spaces analogous to [ Hu96 , Proposition 1.7.1] , where the latter can be viewed as a form of Jacobian criterion for étale maps of noetherian 1 1 1 We point out that every ring considered in [ Hu96 ] satisfies some noetherian conditions, see [ Hu96 , Assumption 1.1.1] , while sous-perfectoid spaces are not always noetherian.

arxiv-2602-14975.title: Faster Molecular Dynamics with Neural Network Potentials via Distilled Multiple Time-Stepping and Non-Conservative Forces
arxiv-2602-14975.creator: Nicolaï Gouraud, Côme Cattin, Thomas Plé, Olivier Adjoua, Louis Lagardère, Jean-Philip Piquemal
arxiv-2602-14975.description: Abstract Following our previous work (J. Phys. Chem. Lett., 2026, 17, 5, 1288–1295), we propose the DMTS-NC approach, a distilled multi-time-step (DMTS) strategy using non conservative (NC) forces to further accelerate atomistic molecular dynamics simulations using foundation neural network models.

pmc-10664211.title: Case Report: Rare Presentation of Nodular Fasciitis over Dorsum of Wrist
pmc-10664211.creator: Ashootosh Batra, Jaya Batra, Tripti Pathare
pmc-10664211.description: Introduction:Nodular fasciitis is a benign, reactive fibroblastic tumor that usually presents as a rapidly growing lesion with occasional involvement of the deep fascia and muscle. We present a case of nodular fasciitis over the dorsum of the wrist. In our knowledge, this is the first reported case of nodular fasciitis at this location in the literature.

pmc-11408526.title: Quantifiable blood TCR repertoire components associate with immune aging
pmc-11408526.creator: Jing Hu, Mingyao Pan, Brett Reid, Shelley Tworoger, Bo Li
pmc-11408526.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). T cell senescence alters the homeostasis of distinct T cell populations and results in decayed adaptive immune protection in older individuals, but a link between aging and dynamic T cell clone changes has not been made. Here, using a newly developed computational framework, Repertoire Functional Units (RFU), we investigate over 6500 publicly available TCR repertoire sequencing samples from multiple human cohorts and identify age-associated RFUs consistently across different cohorts. Quantification of RFU reduction with aging reveals accelerated loss under immunosuppressive conditions.

pmc-11495003.title: Double innominate vein in a case with double aortic arch: a case report
pmc-11495003.creator: Hiroki Ishii, Mika Saito, Tomomi Uyeda, Yuta Kuwahara
pmc-11495003.description: BackgroundDouble aortic arch (DAA) is a type of vascular ring, causing stridor and dysphagia owing to compression of the trachea and esophagus. In contrast, double innominate veins, which is a relatively rare venous anomaly, usually does not cause symptoms or require intervention.

pmc-11511062.title: The Editorial on the Special Issue “Research on Mycotoxins in Food and Feed: From Detection and Unravelling of Toxicity to Control”

pmc-11511062.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). listed at the end of this Editorial. The accepted research articles aimed to investigate the in vitro toxicity of selected mycotoxins as a mixture with other synthetic food contaminants (Contribution 1 and 2); the efficacy of selected biocontrol agents and different maize hybrids under laboratory and field conditions for the preharvest control of toxigenic fungi (Contribution 3 and 4); the potential use of some natural products in mitigating the toxicity caused by aflatoxins in experimental animals (Contribution 5, 6, and 7); and

pmc-11676118.title: CRISPR/Cas9 Edition of the F9 Gene in Human Mesenchymal Stem Cells for Hemophilia B Therapy
pmc-11676118.creator: Irving Jair Lara-Navarro, Luis Felipe Jave-Suárez, Juan Antonio Marchal, Ana Rebeca Jaloma-Cruz, Eleni Gavriilaki
pmc-11676118.description: Hemophilia B is a genetic disorder characterized by clotting factor IX deficiency and bleeding in joints and muscles. Current treatments involve intravenous infusion of plasma-derived products or recombinant proteins, which have limited efficacy due to the short half-life of infused proteins. Recently, gene therapy for bleeding disorders has offered a potential solution.

pmc-12859556.title: A H2-bioreactor for mitochondrial rehabilitation in infected bone defects regeneration
pmc-12859556.creator: Chunru Kong, Chao Si, Haofeng Liu, Yawen Wang, Jiakai Qiao, Xiaoduo Tang, Hongchen Sun, Junhu Zhang, Bei Chang
pmc-12859556.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The repair of infected bone defects (IBDs) presents a significant clinical challenge due to recurrent infections and inflammation. Characterized by reactive oxygen species (ROS) bursts and mitochondrial dysfunction, IBDs generates to a vicious oxidation-inflammation cycle that impairs bone remodeling. To address this, we developed a double-network hydrogel scaffold composed of phenylboronic acid-modified quaternary chitosan and glycidyl methacrylated poly(vinyl alcohol) (QP-P), crosslinked via dynamic boronic ester bonds and covalent bonds, loaded with magnesium microspheres (Mg spheres) (QP-P/Mg).

pmc-13008933.title: Single-cell transcriptomic profiling of human fetal neural stem cells isolated from the subventricular zone
pmc-13008933.creator: Domenico Alessandro Silvestris, Annunziata De Luisi, Diletta Lucia Capobianco, Francesco Di Palma, Daniela Profico, Maurizio Gelati, Andrea Gerbino, Angelo Luigi Vescovi, Maria Svelto, Ernesto Picardi, Graziano Pesole, Francesco Pisani, Anna Maria D'Erchia
pmc-13008933.description: Neural stem cells (NSCs) are self-renewing, multipotent cells capable of differentiating into neurons, astrocytes, and oligodendrocytes. NSCs reside in specific brain niches: the ventricular zone (VZ), the subventricular zone (SVZ) and the subgranular zone of the dentate gyrus (SGZ). Each of these niches orchestrates finely tuned neurogenesis and gliogenesis in both the developing neocortex and the adult brain.

pmc-13021514.title: Heterogeneity in public attitudes and preferences for the deployment of aquifer thermal energy storage
pmc-13021514.creator: Ting Liu, Richard Hanna, Yiannis Kountouris
pmc-13021514.description: Aquifer thermal energy storage (ATES) can contribute to heating and cooling decarbonization by utilizing the thermal capacity of natural aquifers. Securing acceptance and support for deploying ATES at scale requires acknowledging public perceptions and designing systems compatible with public preferences. Here we characterize attitudinal stances and preferences for the deployment of ATES in public buildings in the UK.

pmc-13095838.title: Prolonged duration of action of rocuronium in a preterm infant: a case report
pmc-13095838.creator: T. Willegers, K. de Graaff-Korf
pmc-13095838.description: Prolonged duration of action of rocuronium is rare but has been more frequently reported in infants. Yet it has not been reported in pre-term infants. We present a case of unusually prolonged neuromuscular blockade following a bolus dose of rocuronium administered during rapid sequence induction in a preterm infant leading to difficult weaning from mechanical ventilation.

pmc-13176005.title: Effectiveness, safety, and pharmacoeconomic profile of Sophora flavescens film in the treatment of postpartum vaginal dysbiosis: a non-randomized controlled trial
pmc-13176005.creator: Jiaojiao Zhao, Xiaorang Li, Songsong Tan, Ye Pan, Zhihao Yang, Shuimei Sun, Junjie Lan, Rui Zhang, Huaye Zhao, Linfang Hu, Jiaxue Wang, Wenyi Zheng, Rui He, Chang Xu, Xiaoling Zeng, Jiaxing Zhang
pmc-13176005.description: IntroductionSophora flavescens film (SFF), a topical traditional Chinese medicine that primarily contains matrine, has been approved in China since 2009 for chronic gynecological inflammation. However, evidence regarding its clinical value in the management of postpartum vaginal dysbiosis (PVD) remains limited.

pmc-13209125.title: Thermoelectric Generator Based on Kesterite (Cu2ZnSnS4) Synthesized via Sol–Gel Method
pmc-13209125.creator: Afef Tarhouni, Marcelo Augusto Malagutti, Tanguy Bernard, Narges Ataollahi, Eleonora Isotta, Andrea Chiappini, Hassen Dahman, Lassaad El Mir, Paolo Scardi
pmc-13209125.description: The need for sustainable and cost-effective thermoelectric materials has brought attention to earth-abundant and mineral compounds, like Cu2ZnSnS4 (CZTS). In this work, CZTS nanoparticles (NPs) were synthesized via the sol–gel method using environmentally friendly solvents based on water and ethanol mixtures. The resulting CZTS NPs were then processed into inks through ball milling to produce a thin-film thermoelectric generator (TEG).

pmc-13429587.title: Perceptions and experiences of missed nursing care among junior nurses: a qualitative study using reflexive thematic analysis
pmc-13429587.creator: Rongrong Zhou, Xiaojuan Liu, Bihua shen, Shuirong Zhan, Shu Zhou, Yanjun Mao
pmc-13429587.description: BackgroundMissed nursing care is an important indicator of healthcare quality and patient safety. Junior nurses undergoing the transition from student to professional practitioner are particularly vulnerable to missed nursing care due to limited clinical experience, insufficient professional competence, and challenges in adapting to complex clinical environments.

pmc-13678275.title: Association of Cognitive Function With Event‐Related Potentials and Immune Inflammation in Adolescents With Major Depressive Disorder
pmc-13678275.creator: Lu Yang, Liemin Ruan, Zhongze Lou, Zhenglai Liu, Yiqin Huang, Li Zhang, Yunxin Ji
pmc-13678275.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to investigate cognitive function changes in adolescents with major depressive disorder (MDD) and examine their associations with depression severity, event‐related potentials (ERP), T lymphocyte subsets, and inflammatory cytokines to identify exploratory clinical and biological correlates for cognitive impairment in this population.MethodsWe enrolled 89 adolescent patients with MDD and 30 healthy controls, matched for age and gender.
